notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/sega/nl_spacfury.cpp (NETLIST_START(spacfury), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/spacfury-sound.nets.

The oscillators MAME runs as ideal clocks (CLOCK) are ports, and the timing parts it parks on a rail in their place are listed above; SPLIT_SHARED_OSCILLATORS is off, so each oscillator drives everything the board has it drive. The site holds no Space Fury manual, so there is no sheet here to compare this with.

Not compared with the sheet. MAME's designators, values and pin numbers are taken as MAME has them; the checker shows the netlist is internally consistent (every pin exists, no two outputs fight, nothing floats), which is not the same as matching the board.
